summary: AlembicCore now projects all semantic, auto/hybrid, and legacy vector candidates through the request-scoped non-deprecated knowledge repository before filters, ranking, slicing, or public projection. Missing/deprecated vector IDs are filtered read-only; surviving candidates retain order and scores and refill from the existing over-retrieved pool. Added bounded optional searchMeta.filteredOrphanVectorCount and fail-closed weighted fallback when truth lookup fails. Commits: 4476b3f (RED tests), 9e499809b3721a0d49e78853db4e115515b281ac (implementation).
verification: Baseline: npm test -- test/SearchEngine.test.ts test/SearchPipeline.test.ts => 2 files, 63 tests passed.
RED: semantic/auto orphan-vector focused tests failed because orphan candidates reached detail lookup/ranking; legacy test failed because pre-truth slice queried only the orphan.
GREEN: npm test -- test/SearchEngine.test.ts => 45/45 passed, including semantic, auto/hybrid, legacy, truth-lookup failure, order/score/limit, no-write, and searchMeta cases.
Full suite: npm test => 177 files, 1649 tests passed.
npm run lint => 731 files passed; npm run lint:naming and npm run lint:retired-symbols passed.

That file is outside this task diff and its blob hash 6e88dab655821ed72e9389a7c274b87d07fbecde exactly matches start HEAD f427557.

Read-only proof: SearchEngine vector projection only calls findByIdsDetailSync and source-ref reads; mutation spies for repository insert/update/delete and vector upsert/remove/clear/reconcileIndex were never called.
Worktree clean after commits; final HEAD 9e499809b3721a0d49e78853db4e115515b281ac.
risks: Repository-wide npm run check is not green because of the pre-existing ASTChunker doctrine violation at the task-start blob; this package did not alter that unrelated AST lifetime surface.
Refill uses the existing fixed over-retrieval pool, so results can remain below limit when orphan/filter removals exhaust that pool; no orphan can leak.
Very large caller-supplied limits can enlarge the batched truth lookup; current normal search limits are safe, while a future cap/chunking change would be separate scope.
The truth projection validates row existence and non-deprecated lifecycle without replacing nonempty vector metadata fields, preserving current filter/ranking compatibility.

craftEvidence.value: SearchEngine deduplicated then sliced/supplemented vector hits; _supplementDetails enriched found rows but retained missing IDs, so orphan shells reached filters/ranking/public results. Both production detail queries also admitted deprecated rows.

Baseline focused tests; commit public-entry RED tests for semantic/auto/legacy; implement shared request-DB projection and optional meta; run focused/full/check/build; two-stage spec and quality review; commit and return evidence.

Only AlembicCore SearchEngine, SearchTypes, the two knowledge detail repository queries, and SearchEngine tests changed. No Plugin/Alembic/Agent/Dashboard/vendor/live-data/index mutation or SyncCoordinator changes.

Stage 1 verified all three vector paths filter before filters/ranking/slice, preserve budgets/order/scores, and remain read-only. Stage 2 independent read-only diff review found no blocking issue; optional bounded meta and live-only repository predicates are backward-compatible. Pre-existing AST doctrine failure recorded separately.
